contract_plain_english: For the s-stage additive Runge–Kutta scheme (3.1), analyzed through the perturbed form (3.2), the paper splits the error at each time-step exactly into a scheme approximation part and a perturbation part: E=E_sch+E_per. When the corresponding consistency-order-p and perturbation-order-m conditions hold, these parts have orders O(Δt^(p+1)) and O(εΔt^(m+1)). If the method is stable, the predicted global orders lose one power of Δt, giving O(Δt^p)+O(εΔt^m). [PDF pp. 4-5; anchors: equations (3.1a)-(3.3), unnumbered one-step error display, and following global-error display] The source leaves the norm, state dimension, hidden constants, limiting regime, exact error baseline, and stability notion unspecified, and its printed definition τ=(F-F^ε)/ε has a sign conflict with the printed plus perturbation terms in (3.2). [PDF p. 3; anchor: equation (2.3); PDF p. 5; anchor: equations (3.2a)-(3.2b) and the error displays]
